annotations.title: chainpeek: check a wallet for a drain: tokens pulled out in transactions it did not send

description: chainpeek: Check a wallet for a drain: find tokens pulled out without its signature. For live approvals with revoke transactions use audit_token_approvals. Returns a `verdict` (drained | review | clean) for `wallet` over the latest 2,000 blocks: each transfer out of USDC and USDT (or up to 5 tokens) is sent, authorized (EIP-3009, as x402 uses), wallet_code, pulled (someone else's transaction) or unknown, with the puller and its live allowance, the nonce before and after, and evidence. Drained: a pull to an address the wallet did not pay itself, or pulls of half of a token's holding. Review: other pulls, a balance that fell with an unmoved nonce, smart-account or EIP-7702 wallets. Gasless orders look like pulls. Bad input is a 422, a failed read a 502 (neither charged). Typically 2-10 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/wallet-drain-check-api.html

chain.description: base or ethereum (the chains with built-in USDC and USDT here).
chain.title: Chain

lookback_blocks.description: Instead of `lookback_s`: the latest blocks read, in one range (1-2,000; 2,000 is about 6.7 minutes on Base at 0.2 s and 6.7 hours on Ethereum).
lookback_blocks.title: Lookback Blocks

lookback_s.description: Seconds of history read (1-86,400; default 86,400, 24 hours), cut by block timestamps. Public nodes serve logs only about 8,000 blocks deep: about 27 minutes on Base today (the whole window on Ethereum); `history.from_time`, `history.seconds` and `history.complete` say what was read. Not with `lookback_blocks`.
lookback_s.title: Lookback S

tokens.description: 1 to 5 tokens: USDC, USDT or contract addresses. Default: USDC and USDT.
tokens.title: Tokens
